notes: LOC is wc -l of UE 5.8.3 Renderer/Private/VirtualShadowMaps and Shaders/Private/VirtualShadowMaps files, split by measured line ranges. Rows sum to the SYS row LOC, with the remainder in a Shared and glue internal. The last three rows have no LOC in the map (null).

rows.parent: Page marking and physical page pool
internals: Pixel page marking from receiver footprint
Turns each depth pixel into a requested shadow page at the mip its footprint needs, with a border dilation, back-face skip, depth-of-field and first-person resolution bias.
partial

ReceiverDemandPass (virtual-shadow-pages.ts) computes demand but nothing renders sparse pages. PRD-457 Phase 2 names demand. The refinements (page dilation 0.05, back-facing pixel skip, depth-of-field bias) wait for PRD-457 admitting pages. Propose one PRD-457 box.
Froxel page marking
Experimental path that marks pages from 8 by 8 pixel froxels built during the depth pyramid pass, plus the light grid prune.
deferred
Off by default in Unreal (r.Shadow.Virtual.MarkPagesUsingFroxels 0, approximate by design). Revisit if PRD-457 admits sparse pages and pixel marking is the measured cost.
Coarse page marking
Keeps the coarsest levels resident everywhere so low-resolution data always exists.
shipped
The outer clip levels of VirtualShadowNode cover their whole window every frame, so coarse data always exists by construction.
Hierarchical page flags and mip propagation
Builds the page flags, propagates mapped mips and filterable requests, merges receiver-mask mips.
partial
Page keys and level addressing exist in virtual-shadow-pages.ts. A sparse atlas needs the rest, gated by PRD-457 Phase 1.
Page table addressing and handles
Virtual to physical page lookup helpers shared by marking, rendering and projection.
shipped
DirectionalClipmap and makePageKey/parsePageKey (virtual-shadow-pages.ts) carry the addressing.
Physical page allocation, LRU and eviction
Maps requested pages to physical pages, reuses cached ones, evicts the oldest request first and packs the free list.
partial
PhysicalPagePool does LRU bookkeeping with no atlas behind it. PRD-457 Phase 2 box 1 and 2 name demand, LRU eviction and the bias before fallback.
Static and dynamic page merge, clear and initialize
Selects pages to clear, merges the static page copy into the dynamic one and initializes new pages.
shipped
Static cached levels plus a separate mover map ship (PRD-538 partial redraw, PRD-572 automatic mover detection).
Per-page depth pyramid (HZB)
Builds a depth pyramid for each dirty physical page for two-pass occlusion culling of casters.
open
No pyramid of the light view exists. PRD-716 measures the waste first, then builds the cull.
Prefiltered distant shadows
Experimental separable blur of coarse pages, border gather and merge-down that makes far shadows soft and stable.
deferred
Off by default in Unreal (r.Shadow.Virtual.PrefilteredDistant 0, project-enable read-only 0). Revisit if the horizon scene of PRD-649 shows far-shadow shimmer that the clip levels cannot hide.
Page pool pressure and dynamic resolution throttle
Raises a resolution bias when the pool passes 85 percent. An experimental mode throttles from a shadow-depth time budget.
partial
PRD-457 Phase 2 box 1 names the bias before any fallback. ShadowFilterBudget and adaptiveRefresh step cost from measurement (PRD-652 done phase). The time-budget mode is experimental in Unreal.
Shadow depth rendering into pages
Nanite and non-Nanite draw passes, culling dispatch and per-page view setup for the depth render.
partial
VirtualShadowNode renders levels with the ordinary renderer. Clustered casters get their own cut in PRD-602 and compute raster in PRD-696.
Array setup, slot allocation and uniform buffers
Per-frame setup of shadow map slots, uniform buffers and sampling parameters.
shipped
VirtualShadowNode owns its levels and uniforms.
CVars, scalability tiers and defaults
The console variables that set page pool size, biases, ray counts and marking modes per quality level.
partial
PRD-652 carries the tier table (sample counts, directional bias, page pool).
Page-management dispatcher and shader declarations
Per-page compute dispatch machinery and shader permutation declarations.
rule
C++ and shader plumbing for the DirectX/Vulkan path. WebGPU and the owned engine dispatch their own passes.
Debug overlays and stats readback in the array code
Stats logging, light search for the visualizer, caster bounds draw and visualization passes inside the array code.
open
PRD-676 reports the shadow-level view. The TN_VIRTUAL_SHADOW marker already ships.
Receiver masks and instance-to-page overlap tests
Tests whether an instance rectangle overlaps pages that hold visible receivers or are occluded.
open
PRD-716 gates and builds the receiver test with the light-view cull.
Shared and glue
Lines of the row that no single internal owns.
rule
Types, packing and helpers that every internal of this row uses. Any implementation needs them, so no PRD tracks them.
Directional projection and clip-level pick
Chooses a clip level per pixel and blends to the next near the level edge.
shipped
VirtualShadowNode reads the finest covering level first and stops when the blend weight is spent (PRD-634 round 2).
Shadow-map ray tracing (SMRT) ray loop
Shoots 7 to 8 rays of 4 to 8 samples across the source disc through the shadow map for a penumbra that grows with the caster gap.
partial
PRD-634 and PRD-650 copy the effect with a blocker-search filter, not the method, by design. PRD-652 sets the sample counts per tier.
Adaptive ray count early exit
After the first ray, a group of pixels that all missed leaves the loop. After N rays, a group that all hit also leaves.
open
The source-angle filter always loads 16 blocker and 16 filter texels. PRD-715 gates the exit by measurement.
Screen-space start ray (smart bias)
A 4-step depth-buffer ray of 1.5 percent of scene depth that tells the shadow ray where to start.
open
PRD-649 only measures it by ablation. PRD-715 builds it if the contact delta passes. Not the declined contact shadow of PRD-561.
Normal bias, slope bias and geometric normal estimate
Offsets the lookup along the normal by an amount that follows camera distance and lens, then adds a slope bias from the receiver plane.
partial
receiverPlaneBias ships (slope). The normal offset is a fixed world-unit constant. PRD-715 Phase 2.
Local-light projection (cube face, footprint mip, spot and point)
Picks the cube face and the mip from the pixel footprint for point and spot lights.
partial
PRD-650 sizes each lamp map from the pixels it covers and widens its penumbra with the lamp radius.
Page lookup, clipmap level selection and level blend
Looks a texel up through the page table, offsets to coarser levels and converts between level bases.
shipped
Level selection and blend ship in the receiver. Reach to the horizon is PRD-634.
Prefiltered distant sampling
Samples the blurred distant pages for far shadows.
deferred
Same switch as the prefiltered distant pages. Off by default in Unreal.
Projection passes and shadow-mask composite
Per-light projection into a shadow mask, composite into a screen mask, packed formats and mask clears.
shipped
ThreeNative evaluates the shadow in the material, so it needs no screen mask. Glue of a deferred renderer.
One-pass projection and per-pixel light list
Projects all lights of a pixel in the lighting pass from a clustered light grid, up to 16 lights.
deferred
Needs clustered deferred lighting. Revisit with PRD-660 if many shadowed lamps become a measured cost.
Hair strand shadow rays
A single-sample shadow ray path for strand hair.
deferred
Revisit when PRD-671 (strand hair) ships and a hair shadow looks wrong.

deferred
